question: Should OpenClaw accept `currentTokenCount` plus token-budget SDK helpers as a stable public ContextEngine/plugin SDK contract now, or fold token/headroom metadata into the broader assemble metadata work tracked by #82137?
rationale: This is an additive but public plugin API contract, and automation cannot decide whether the narrow field should become stable separately from the broader assemble metadata RFC.

options.title: Accept Narrow Contract After Repairs
options.body: Keep this PR open, require the message/count alignment fix, SDK baseline update, and live proof, then land if the narrow API direction is approved.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Metadata RFC
options.body: Pause or close this PR and route token headroom into the broader #82137 assemble metadata design so engines receive one coherent contract.

options.title: Accept Contract Risk Now
options.body: Merge despite the current contract/proof gaps only if maintainers explicitly accept the plugin API compatibility risk.

recommendation.title: Accept Narrow Contract After Repairs
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open, require the message/count alignment fix, SDK baseline update, and live proof, then land if the narrow API direction is approved.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned to the PR and have the most recent directly related context-engine budget/runtime-context history.
